create_sana_pipeline: create a SanaPipeline instance from a pretrained model for text-to-image generation
run_sana_generation: run the SanaPipeline __call__ method to generate images from a text prompt with guidance
encode_sana_prompt: encode a text prompt into Gemma transformer hidden state embeddings with attention masks
prepare_sana_latents: prepare random noise latents for Sana diffusion with configurable batch size and resolution
clean_sana_caption: clean and preprocess a caption string by removing URLs, HTML, special characters, and normalizing text
